key_catalyst: Accelerating rotation out of AI/semiconductor names (Micron -8.9%, AMD -8.1%, AMAT -7.8%) into cyclicals, compounded by tonight's FOMC decision and after-close Microsoft/Meta earnings
reasoning: QQQ has fallen four consecutive sessions (-1.90%, -1.12%, -0.31%, -0.97% from 07-23 through 07-28) as the AI-capex-scrutiny theme escalated from an Alphabet/Tesla earnings problem into a full semiconductor de-rating, and today that theme escalates again with Micron -8.9%, AMD -8.1%, and Applied Materials -7.8% while the Dow rose 1% — a rotation, not a broad risk-off flush that mean-reverts. Today stacks two unresolved binary events on top of that: the FOMC decision with a still-elevated ~31.5% hike probability and Microsoft/Meta reporting after the close, both landing before the next session with no cushion. Notably, the one clear bullish input (Brent -4.4% on the US-Iran pause) failed to lift the index on 07-28 and is failing again pre-market, which shows tech is not being bought even when the macro excuse improves.
